method: population = every `harness:*` script in package.json, resolved to its scratchpad/*.mjs file
each file's source has // and /* */ comments stripped (strings/template literals respected) BEFORE matching
NON_LAUNCHER  = no `spawnGuarded(` call in the stripped source
KILLTREE      = launches AND calls `killTree(` or `killTreeSync(` itself
SELFKILL      = launches, never calls killTree itself, relies on the exit net

note_comment_only.what_it_is: these files name killTree() only inside a comment (and several import the symbol without ever calling it); an unstripped grep would mis-sort every one of them into KILLTREE

step1.non_launchers_cannot_reach_the_reaper: harness-guard.mjs installNet() (line ~1044) loops only over children registered by spawnGuarded; with none registered, killTreeSync/reapDisplays is never called

A fixed-duration wait is not a wait.
